title: Count Root-to-Leaf Paths with Sum K
problemStatement: Given a binary tree whose nodes contain integer values and an integer K, determine the number of root-to-leaf paths whose node values sum to exactly K.
input: • The first line contains an integer N. • The second line contains the node values. • The next N lines describe the binary tree. • The last line contains K.
output: • Print the number of qualifying paths.
